spans.s: khakkhaṭa, adj. (= kakkhaṭa, q.v.; cited by Thomas JRAS 〔1899.494〕 from Harṣac.; see next), hard: Śikṣ 〔342.3〕 (so ms.); MSV 〔iv.75.8〕; harsh (of sounds), Divy 〔518.2〕 (vs) (dviṣṭo naṛo bhavati hi) khakkhaṭā-svaraḥ (ā m.c.? MIndic pron. -saraḥ).

khakkhaṭatva, nt., also spelled khakhaṭa˚ (to prec.), hardness: Mvy 〔1842〕 (v.l. kakkh˚; opp. to dravatvam) = [] Tib. sra ba ñid; (= kakkha˚ Śikṣ 〔245.2〕;) Bcṭ 〔328.6〕 (and with var. 〔327.12〕); spelled khakhaṭatvam Mmk 〔265.20〕 (gātre).
khakkhara, nt. (= khakhara-ka, khaṅkhara-ka, qq.v.), monkʼs staff: Mvy 〔8955〕 = Tib. ḥkhar bsil (or gsil), id.
khakkhala, adj. (doubtless onomat.), stammering (so Tib., dig pa): Mvy 〔8887〕.
